name: Kalman Filter
summary: Recursive linear-Gaussian state estimation for a dynamical system with noisy measurements.
core_idea: Alternate model prediction and covariance-weighted observation updates.
innovation: Transforms sequential state inference into prediction-update recursions with uncertainty propagation.
limitations: Linear-Gaussian assumptions are essential to the classical optimality result.
Covariances become expensive in very high dimensions.

start_here.why: Pedagogical foundation for sequential assimilation and later ensemble methods.
Original landmark for recursive state-space filtering.
start_here.focus: State transition model and covariance update; historical context.

curation_note: Core method concept and checked source(s) recorded; suggested readings remain advisory and may be revised.
